ev.q: Weighted data were used to produce national vaccination coverage estimates.
Reported hepatitis B vaccination coverage (≥3 doses) among adults was 25.0%
Among adults aged ≥65 years, coverage was 59.7% overall
Coverage among whites aged ≥65 years (63.6%) was higher compared with blacks (48.7%)
Among adults aged 19–49 years, vaccination coverage was lower for blacks (30.5%) and Hispanics (23.7%) compared with whites (35.2%)
The NHIS collects information about the health and health care of the noninstitutionalized U.S. civilian population
Herpes zoster vaccination coverage increased in 2013 compared with 2012
the 2013 estimate 6 percentage points below the Healthy People 2020 target of 30%

methods_quotes.q: Weighted data were used to produce national vaccination coverage estimates.
Point estimates and estimates of corresponding variances were calculated using statistical software to account for the complex sample design.
Statistical significance was defined as p<0.05.
p<0.05 by t-test for comparisons, with non-Hispanic white as the reference.
p<0.05 by t-test for comparisons between 2013 and 2012 within each level of each characteristic.
Sensitivity calculations were conducted to assess the magnitude of potential bias.
